capabilities: Add custom search commands for any website with URL-based search
Insert a prompted query into a URL via the %s placeholder
Open placeholder-free URLs instantly from the command palette
Modify or remove the default search commands
extras: Supports the legacy ${Q} replacement string for backward compatibility; links open in the browser unless the core Web Viewer plugin is enabled. Donation link via PayPal.
problem: Searching the web from Obsidian requires leaving to a browser and manually opening sites; there is no built-in way to run configured search URLs from the command palette.

relations.evidence: For the best experience, enable the core plugin Web Viewer; otherwise the links open outside of Obsidian

summary: Web-search launcher that adds custom URL-based search commands to Obsidian's command palette, replacing a placeholder with your query.
